[{"role": "user", "content": "Why is the sky blue?"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "Because of Rayleigh scattering: shorter wavelengths of light are scattered more by the atmosphere."}]
[{"role": "assistant", "content": "Violet scatters even more, but sunlight contains less violet and our eyes are less sensitive to it, so we see blue."}]
